description: Hawai'i Social Network Analysis is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Climate and Societal Interactions Division CAP-RISA; Pacific Regional Integrated Sciences and Assessments (Pacific RISA). Consult these social network maps of climate change stakeholders to find collaborators or experts in different fields of study or locations in Hawai'i and the U.S.-Affiliated Pacific Islands region. Coverage: Hawai'i and the U.S.-Affiliated Pacific Islands region. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
